$comment: Recipe sites for AI_PROVIDER=mock with a localhost SITE_URL (src/server/fetch/index.ts, fixture-sites.ts): tests, E2E and CI fetch these instead of the internet.
Each page: url and file (a saved page), status (an HTTP error), redirect (a Location, status 301 unless given),
hang (never answers, so safeFetch's 10 s run out) or bytes (an HTML page of that size, without Content-Length).
koket-chow-mein.html and tasteline-bakad-fetaost.html were saved once with `pnpm sites:probe --save`, only as test input.
The only edit: tasteline's Cloudflare analytics beacon was removed, since its public site token trips gitleaks.
Addresses under /matkoll-test/ do not exist on the real sites; they give the import flow's error cases.
The ica-erbjudanden*.html pages (Story 9.1) are written by hand in the shape of ICA's offer page: made-up items and stores, a made-up token and cookie, no addresses, footer or images.
In them, {{sunday}} and {{sunday+N}} become this week's Sunday (plus N days) when served, so the page is this week's (fixture-sites.ts).
The /erbjudanden/matkoll-test-*-100000N/ addresses do not exist on ica.se; https://www.ica.se/ stands in for the start page a moved link redirects to.
